summary: Slow SPA boot driven by render-blocking JS chunks, an image-heavy page, and one site-origin console error on the search header.

performance.title: Main-thread JS chunks slow to first byte
performance.detail: Several _next/static/chunks/*.js requests show ~700ms server wait before any bytes, render-blocking the SPA boot.

network.title: images.wegmans.com dominates page weight
network.detail: 70 requests / 6.6 MB from the image host; a single hero image is 2.2 MB. Serve responsive/next-gen formats.
network.evidence: hero image 2.2 MB of 6.6 MB total

errors.title: Invalid discovery pages storage data
errors.detail: The search header logs a console error on load — relevant to a search monitor; likely corrupt localStorage state in SiteHeaderSearch.

suggestions.title: Two CSS chunks preloaded but unused
suggestions.detail: Wasted preloads observed within the first few seconds.

caveats: Web Vitals are best-effort for this SPA's soft navigations — lean on network/console/payload signals.
Not a real Lighthouse audit — suggestions are based on the trace's network/console data.
